# Twitter / X — 2009

The origin year of @danfrank. The voice is already the one the later corpora treat as architectural: lowercase, fragment, ellipsis, in-love-and-bored in the same hour. The scraped remainder of the year is still landing; what is on this page so far runs from late October (packing for PA, airport businessmen-talk, Saw VI / Steelers / home to the O, then birthday/Halloween/Jesters, "maybe I'll one day be a hip hop producer") through Thanksgiving travel (Pitt/WVU, "no longer consider myself a republican") into the late-December Full Sail / Alexis / I-95 home-for-the-holidays cluster.

## Gaps

The operator spreadsheet begins 2013-08-17. 2009 is being walked from live X search in batches of ten; this page currently holds 165 originals and will be appended as further batches land. Do not treat the present count as the year's total.

This page is the text archive. Every original and every quote-tweet with Dan's own text that has been retrieved for the year is below, oldest first. Pure reposts with no @danfrank quote content are omitted.
